common: The exact Hover auditor robot from the two reference images: round ivory shell, dark glass face with two mint glowing eyes, mint visor, antenna, two small attached arms, mint thruster nozzle underneath. One robot, centered, fully in frame, floating in empty dark blue charcoal studio space. Preserve its identity and proportions. Smooth continuous animation from the starting pose to the ending pose, soft rim light, stable camera.
negative: detached arm, floating hand, separated limb, stamp leaving the hand, extra objects, table, platform, floor, ground plane, green surface, second robot, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, changed design, changed colors, extra eyes, extra arms, morphing, melting, distorted face, jitter, flicker, sudden cuts, blur, low quality

stamp-press.prompt: The robot lifts the stamp and presses it down firmly in one clear motion. Its arm stays attached to its body and its hand keeps holding the stamp throughout. A small body bounce follows the firm press, then it settles into the stamp-down ending pose. Camera still.

turn-point.prompt: The robot turns toward the right and raises its arm to point to the right. Its arm stays attached as it extends smoothly into the pointing ending pose. A gentle hovering body tilt follows the gesture. Camera still.

think-approve.prompt: The robot finishes thinking, brightens with a cheerful expression and gives a happy thumbs-up. Its attached arm moves smoothly from the thinking pose into the approving ending pose, with a small delighted body bounce. Camera still.

inspect-present.prompt: The robot lowers the magnifying glass and presents a blank page toward the camera. Its attached arms move smoothly from inspecting to the presenting ending pose. The page stays completely blank. The robot steadies in a gentle hover. Camera still.
